Within Eras

When ENHYPEN Rejected the Correct Path

Blessed-Cursed marks the point where ENHYPEN stop searching for the correct path and choose a self-authored one instead.

Introduction

“Blessed-Cursed” marks one of the clearest turning points in ENHYPEN’s narrative. Rather than continuing to search for the “right” answer, the group rejects the idea that such an answer exists if it is defined by other people. Across DIMENSION: DILEMMA, DIMENSION: ANSWER and MANIFESTO: DAY 1, ENHYPEN’s storyline evolves from confusion over competing desires into an explicit commitment to self-determination. Instead of asking which path society approves, they decide to author their own future, even if that choice invites conflict. This shift is not simply a change in musical style or visual concept; it is the mechanism that connects the uncertainty of the Dimension era with the collective confidence of Manifesto. Official album narratives consistently frame this progression as a movement from questioning identity to rejecting imposed identities altogether.[BELIFT LAB]beliftlab.comBELIFT LAB빌리프랩 | BELIFT LABBELIFT LAB빌리프랩 | BELIFT LAB

How Dimension turns desire into an identity crisis

The Dimension era begins with a world that is more complicated than the members expected after crossing the metaphorical border established in their debut series. According to BELIFT LAB, the protagonists discover that conflicting values, ambitions and expectations force them to confront desires they had never previously recognised. Instead of finding certainty, they become trapped between incompatible possibilities, questioning who they really are.[BELIFT LAB]beliftlab.comBELIFT LAB빌리프랩 | BELIFT LABBELIFT LAB빌리프랩 | BELIFT LAB

“Tamed-Dashed” illustrates this tension through its central contradiction. Even the title presents two incompatible states: remaining controlled or breaking free. Rather than offering a resolution, the song depicts young people caught between externally approved choices and internal impulses. The official description of DIMENSION: DILEMMA emphasises that the members cannot yet identify the correct direction, so they simply continue moving forward in hopes of discovering answers later.[BELIFT LAB]beliftlab.comBELIFT LAB빌리프랩 | BELIFT LABBELIFT LAB빌리프랩 | BELIFT LAB

This uncertainty is significant because it transforms desire into an identity problem. Earlier albums explored the excitement and confusion of entering a new world, but Dimension asks a different question: if every available path has been shaped by someone else’s expectations, how can an authentic identity emerge?

Why Blessed-Cursed rejects society’s approved answer

The repackage album DIMENSION: ANSWER fundamentally changes the group’s position. Rather than continuing the search for approval, ENHYPEN begin questioning the authority of the system that claims to possess the “correct” answer in the first place.

BELIFT LAB’s official description is unusually explicit about this shift. The members recognise a society driven by competition, constant comparison and social media pressures. What once appeared to be a blessing—accepting prescribed rules and succeeding within them—comes to feel like a curse. The title track becomes a declaration: “I’ll go my own way.”[BELIFT LAB]beliftlab.comBELIFT LAB빌리프랩 | BELIFT LABBELIFT LAB빌리프랩 | BELIFT LAB

This reversal explains the apparent contradiction in the song’s title.

  • “Blessed” represents acceptance, privilege and apparent success under existing rules.
  • “Cursed” represents the loss of innocence once those rules are understood as restrictive rather than liberating.
  • The song argues that comfort obtained through conformity is no longer genuine freedom.

Instead of portraying rebellion as impulsive teenage defiance, the album frames it as an informed decision. The protagonists first understand how the system operates before consciously refusing to define themselves by its expectations.[BELIFT LAB]beliftlab.comBELIFT LAB빌리프랩 | BELIFT LABBELIFT LAB빌리프랩 | BELIFT LAB

The accompanying visual language reinforces this message. Earlier eras frequently contrasted elegant uniforms, ritualised settings and carefully ordered spaces with moments of emotional instability. In “Blessed-Cursed,” vintage hip-hop styling, industrial environments and more direct choreography replace much of that symbolism, reflecting a move away from inherited roles towards self-expression. Even later live performances retained this old-school streetwear aesthetic for “Blessed-Cursed,” linking its visual identity to independence rather than fantasy alone.[Teen Vogue]teenvogue.comTeen Vogue ENHYPEN Take Us Backstage at "Manifesto" World Tour in New York Citystop of their Manifesto world tour. From private awakening to public declaration

One reason “Blessed-Cursed” occupies such an important place in ENHYPEN’s broader storyline is that it changes the scale of the conflict.

Earlier albums focus primarily on internal uncertainty:

  • Should they follow expectations or personal desire?
  • Can they trust their own instincts?
  • What does success actually mean?

After “Blessed-Cursed,” those questions become decisions rather than dilemmas. The conflict is no longer internal confusion but external resistance against systems that expect obedience.

This distinction matters because identity becomes something actively created rather than passively discovered. The members stop waiting for permission to define themselves.

How Manifesto transforms private doubt into collective rebellion

MANIFESTO: DAY 1 does not repeat the message of “Blessed-Cursed”; it expands it.

BELIFT LAB describes the album as portraying the members taking control of their own lives and drawing a new future for themselves. Rather than merely refusing existing expectations, they now invite others to join them. The lead single “Future Perfect (Pass the MIC)” frames leadership as collective action rather than individual escape, declaring, “We’ll take the lead forward. Come along with us.”[BELIFT LAB]beliftlab.comBELIFT LAB빌리프랩 | BELIFT LABBELIFT LAB빌리프랩 | BELIFT LAB

The change is also visible in ENHYPEN’s broader conceptual framing. As analysed by Weverse Magazine, the group’s earlier title tracks all contained a symbolic hyphen—”Given-Taken,” “Drunk-Dazed,” “Tamed-Dashed” and “Blessed-Cursed.” These paired oppositions reflected young people suspended between conflicting identities. MANIFESTO: DAY 1 deliberately abandons that naming pattern. The publication interprets this as signalling the end of ENHYPEN’s “hyphenated era”: instead of existing between alternatives, they begin drawing their own lines.[Weverse Magazine]magazine.weverse.ioMagazine ENHYPEN’s next declarationWeverse MagazineENHYPEN’s next declaration - Weverse Magazine…

This progression can be understood as three distinct stages:

EraCentral questionResponseDIMENSION: DILEMMAWho am I among conflicting desires?Continue searching.DIMENSION: ANSWERMust I accept society’s answer?Reject imposed identities.MANIFESTO: DAY 1What comes after rejection?Build a new direction together.

Rather than treating rebellion as an endpoint, Manifesto portrays it as the beginning of responsibility. Freedom is meaningful only when it becomes the basis for a new future instead of simply an escape from the old one.[BELIFT LAB]beliftlab.comBELIFT LAB빌리프랩 | BELIFT LABBELIFT LAB빌리프랩 | BELIFT LAB

Why this turning point matters within ENHYPEN’s larger story

Viewed within ENHYPEN’s narrative arc, “Blessed-Cursed” functions as the bridge between uncertainty and conviction.

The Border series explored entering an unfamiliar world. Dimension exposed the psychological cost of navigating that world while trying to satisfy competing expectations. “Blessed-Cursed” ends the search for externally validated identity by rejecting the assumption that conformity equals success. Manifesto then converts that personal awakening into a shared declaration capable of leading others.

Because of this progression, “Blessed-Cursed” represents more than a title track between two album cycles. It is the moment when ENHYPEN stop asking which path is correct and instead claim the authority to decide what “correct” means for themselves. That decision becomes the emotional foundation for every subsequent era, where choices are no longer made from confusion but from a consciously asserted identity.[BELIFT LAB]beliftlab.comBELIFT LAB빌리프랩 | BELIFT LABBELIFT LAB빌리프랩 | BELIFT LAB
